text.p: Barcelona of Spain beat AIK Stockholm of Sweden 3-1 in their European Cup Winners' Cup quarter-final first leg match on Thursday.
Barcelona - Gheorghe Popescu 2, Ronaldo 55, Juan Pizzi 75

Barcelona: 13-Carlos Busquets, 2-Albert Ferrer (10-Giovanni 46), 4-Josep Guardiola, 5-Gheorghe Popescu (19-Juan Pizzi 69), 7-Luis Figo, 8-Hristo Stoichkov (23-Ivan de la Pena 69) , 9-Ronaldo, 12-Sergi Barjuan, 15-Laurent Blanc , 20-Miguel Angel Nadal, 21-Luis Enrique Martinez

AIK: 1-Magnus Hedman, 2-Krister Nordin 3-Millqvist, 4-Ola Andersson, 5-Brundin, 6-Johansson (13-Dick Lidman 85), 9-Pascal Simpson, 10-Johan Mjallby, 17-Pierre Gallo, 26-Gary Sundgren, 27-Novakovic (15-Pacha).
